name: warrior-of-the-fae-realm-banished-sword-not-activatable-same-turn
notes: Warrior of the Fae Realm (eRcqucBKhX): "you may activate the banished card on a later turn." Player 1 plays the Warrior on turn 2 of the game (their second turn, so the first-turn attack lock cannot be the cause of a refusal) and banishes a Striking Tides; the immediate click on the banished card is accepted by the engine as a no-op (an FSM click that matches no branch does not reject, so the refusal is asserted on state): the card stays banished with only the first-stage tag, no payment is requested or made, nothing resolves and the opposing champion takes no damage. The same click on a later turn starts a real activation in warrior-of-the-fae-realm-banished-sword-activatable-on-later-turn. Replaces warrior-of-the-fae-realm-banished-sword-activatable-same-turn, which pinned the old behavior (same-turn activation proceeded and dealt 4).

rulesClauses: As long as you control Warrior of the Fae Realm, you may activate the banished card on a later turn.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. The Sword attack banished by the Warrior's own On Enter could be activated immediately in the SAME turn although the text only grants activation 'on a later turn'. The banished Sword attack tag (_warriorFaeRealm) was stripped by the end-of-turn banish-zone cleanup in Custom/GameLogic.php ExpireEffects() (it retained only _seethingIntercession), and the ActionMap 'myBanish' branch checked only the tag + Warrior on field with no 'banished on an earlier turn' test. Fix: the cleanup retains _warriorFaeRealm and stamps _warriorFaeRealmLater the first time a turn ends after the banish; new WarriorFaeRealmCanActivateBanished() (tag AND later-stamp AND Warrior on the controller's field) gates both the ActionMap click and the green highlight, and the tags are stripped when the card moves to hand.
engineBug.affectedFunction: Custom/GameLogic.php ActionMap() case 'myBanish' (_warriorFaeRealm branch); ExpireEffects() banish-zone cleanup (later-turn stamp); new WarriorFaeRealmCanActivateBanished()
engineBug.verification: Per-step state dump: after the same-turn click the banish zone, memory, graveyard and champion damage are identical to the pre-click state. Break/restore recorded in the fix commit message.
